description: Analyze a domain's SPF record for ONE domain — the include tree and the RFC 10-DNS-lookup-limit verdict. Use only when the question is specifically about SPF (include tree, lookup count, the `all` qualifier). For an overall "is email secure" grade, use email_security_check instead. One domain per call.

domain.description: The single domain to analyze, e.g. "acme.com".
